_provenance.note: Streams mechanically built from the normative rules quoted in whatwg-9.2.6-normative.txt; official-yhoo-example is verbatim from the example

cases.name: bom
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6: 'The UTF-8 decode algorithm strips one leading UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM), if any.'

cases.name: crlf-terminators
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6: CRLF character pair is a line terminator

cases.name: cr-only-terminators
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6: a single CR not followed by LF is a line terminator

cases.name: comment-lines
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6: 'If the line starts with a U+003A COLON character (:) Ignore the line.'

cases.name: field-value-no-space
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6: 'If value starts with a U+0020 SPACE character, remove it' -- removal is optional-on

cases.name: field-value-single-space-only
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6: only ONE leading space is removed (JSON tolerates the remainder)

cases.name: unknown-field-ignored
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6 process field: 'Otherwise: The field is ignored.'

cases.name: event-field-not-message
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6 dispatch step 5: non-empty event type buffer dispatches a CUSTOM event, not 'message'

cases.name: event-field-scoped-to-one-event
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6 dispatch step 7: 'Set the data buffer and the event type buffer to the empty string'

cases.name: empty-data-buffer-not-dispatched
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6 dispatch step 2: 'If the data buffer is an empty string, ... return'

cases.name: official-yhoo-example
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6 example stream (data: YHOO / data: +2 / data: 10)

cases.name: incomplete-event-at-eof
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6: 'If the file ends in the middle of an event, before the final empty line, the incomplete event is not dispatched.' DEVIATION (see README): hotdog dispatches a complete JSON payload as soon as its data LINE ends -- line granularity, no final blank line required

cases.name: truncated-json-at-eof
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6: incomplete event at EOF is discarded

cases.name: multi-line-data-json
cases.cite: WHATWG 9.2.6: 'Append the field value to the data buffer, then append a single LF' -- for a JSON payload split across data lines the LF joins tokens; JSON is whitespace-insensitive between tokens, so hotdog's newline-less concat parses identically
